title: Graphic EQ
text: Standards-based graphic equalizer, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Bandwidth} sets Filter bandwidth; {EQ Order} sets the order of individual equalizer bands, {Structure} sets the type of implementation, {Gains} sets the gain of each octave or fractional octave, {Variable name}, {Overwrite variable if it already exists}, {Export filter to workspace}, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: EQ Order
params.values: Order of individual equalizer bands 2 (default) | positive even integer

params.name: Gains
params.values: Gain of each octave or fractional octave band (dB) 0 | scalar

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Variable name of exported filter myFilt (default) | valid variable name

params.name: Overwrite variable if it already exists
params.values: Overwrite variable if it already exists on (default) | off

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
